title: Creamy Tomato Butter Chicken
summary: A rich Indian-style butter chicken with tender pieces of chicken simmered in a spiced tomato, butter and cream sauce. Serve it for a comforting gluten-free dinner with rice or your favourite gluten-free flatbread.

ingredients.name: chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces

steps: Mix the yogurt, lemon juice, half the garlic, half the ginger, cumin, ground coriander, paprika, turmeric, chilli powder and 0.75 tsp salt in a bowl. Add the chicken and turn to coat well. Marinate for 15 minutes while you prepare the sauce ingredients, or longer in the fridge if you have time.

Heat the vegetable oil in a large frying pan or wide saucepan over medium-high heat. Add the marinated chicken in a single layer, shaking off excess marinade, and cook for 5–6 minutes, turning once, until lightly browned on the outside. It does not need to be fully cooked through. Transfer to a plate.
Reduce the heat to medium and add the butter to the same pan. Add the onion and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring often, until soft and golden at the edges.
Stir in the remaining garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the tomato paste and cook for another minute, stirring, until it darkens slightly.
Add the canned tomatoes, curry powder and remaining 0.5 tsp salt. Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens and the tomatoes taste mellow.

For a smoother sauce, mash well with a spoon or briefly blend carefully. Return the chicken and any juices to the pan, then simmer gently for 8–10 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and tender.
Stir in the double cream and simmer for 2–3 minutes until the sauce is glossy, creamy and lightly thickened. Taste and adjust salt if needed.
Meanwhile cook the white rice according to packet instructions until tender. Serve the butter chicken over the rice, scattered with fresh coriander.
